statement: Share of firms using AI to produce goods or services >= 2x its 2025 average (Bloc A Census Bureau BTOS, 2027Q4)
status_at_phase_end: 2025 is the baseline year. Original-wording series ('in producing goods or services'): 6.3% (Jan) rising to 10.0% (Oct 2025); Jan-Oct 2025 monthly average ~8.4%, so 2x ~ 16.8%. The question was broadened from the 2025-11-17 collection ('in any of its business functions'), with a new time series from the 2025-12-04 release: Dec 2025 17.3%. No November value on either basis. The baseline therefore covers only Jan-Oct, and the 2027 reading will be on a different question (series break; method decision pending, shared with I-R6-04).

items.summary: Early-2025 reading of the statistics office's biweekly firm survey: 6.3% of firms used AI in producing goods or services (January 2025 average), up from 4.8% in January 2024; expected use in six months 9.3%.
items.detail: Bloc A Census BTOS national monthly average Jan 2025 = 6.3% (Jan 2024 4.8%), as tabulated in Census 'BTOS AI Core Question Updates' (2025-12-03). Release date approximate (BTOS publishes biweekly; mid-Feb for January cycles).

items.summary: Mid-year reading: firm AI use in production reached 9.2% (June 2025), up ~46% since January, then levelled off at ~9.3-9.4% through September.
items.detail: Bloc A Census BTOS monthly averages: Mar 7.4, Apr 7.9, May 8.6, Jun 9.2, Jul 9.3, Aug 9.4, Sep 9.3 (%). Release date approximate (early July for June cycles).

items.summary: Last reading on the original wording: 10.0% of firms used AI in producing goods or services (October 2025); expected use 14.1%. Information sector 29%, finance and insurance 17%.
items.detail: Bloc A Census BTOS Oct 2025 monthly average (last full month before the wording change). Release date approximate; federal shutdown Oct-Nov 2025 may have delayed publication.

items.summary: The statistics office replaced 'in producing goods or services' with 'in any of its business functions' from the 2025-11-17 collection and started a new time series from the 2025-12-04 release, citing a level shift; the original question is no longer asked. The series named by this indicator ends in October 2025.
items.detail: Bloc A Census Bureau, 'BTOS AI Core Question Updates' (dated 2025-12-03, verified). Cognitive testing from early 2025 found respondents using AI in hiring, accounting, R&D, etc. answered 'no' under the old wording. Old data kept in 'AI Core Questions (Original)' table.

items.summary: First reading on the new, broader question: 17.3% of firms used AI in any business function (December 2025 average); expected use in six months 21.1%. About 1.7x the last original-wording value, which roughly measures the level shift.
items.detail: Bloc A Census BTOS new series, first released 2025-12-04; Dec 2025 national average 17.3% (Census update PDF; same figure in EIG 'How Many Businesses Are Using AI?').

items.summary: Derived baseline: the mean of the January-October 2025 monthly averages on the original wording is ~8.4%, so the indicator threshold on that basis would be ~16.8%. The new-wording December value (17.3%) already exceeds that figure, which shows the threshold cannot be applied across the break without a splice.
items.detail: Own calculation from Census table: (6.3+6.8+7.4+7.9+8.6+9.2+9.3+9.4+9.3+10.0)/10 = 8.42%. Not a published statistic.

items.summary: No comparable high-frequency firm AI-use series exists for Bloc B; only Bloc A data are available for this indicator.
items.detail: No Bloc B NBS biweekly or quarterly firm AI-adoption series found.
